## Summary

- Describe the change in 1-3 sentences.
- Link the issue, discussion, or context if applicable.

## Changes

- What changed?
- Why was it needed?
- Anything intentionally left out?

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] README or examples updated when the public API changed

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change scoped and backwards-compatible, or documented the breakage
- [ ] I added or updated tests for user-facing behavior
- [ ] I updated docs when the feature surface changed
